title: The Great Nothing
hook: Your night sky is a lie because of the Bootes void.
script: Your night sky is a lie because of the Bootes void. It is a region of space 330 million light-years across that is almost completely empty. If you replaced every star in the universe with a grain of sand, this gap would be larger than a football stadium. What if our galaxy floated in the middle of this hole? The night sky would look starless, because the nearest galaxies would be hundreds of millions of light-years away. We would not have known other galaxies existed until the 1960s. This void formed through galactic cannibalism, where dense regions pulled matter away from the empty ones. It contains only a few dozen galaxies where thousands should be. Most people think space is evenly filled, but this proves the universe is fundamentally lumpy. Would you prefer a crowded sky or total cosmic silence?
